lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Data: Scaled Graphs and Measurement Line Plots
lessonRef.title: Targeted correction and reassessment: scale and interpretation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Each example contains the correction, not just the answer.

items.prompt: A line plot shows 5 pencil lengths to the nearest 1/2 inch: 1/2, 1/2, 1, 1, 3/2. How many pencils measured exactly 1/2 inch?

steps: Two of the recorded lengths are 1/2 inch.

items.prompt: A scaled bar graph uses a scale of 5 per symbol. A bar shows 3 symbols. What does that bar represent?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Before solving, say which error the problem is testing for.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 1 per symbol, "Dogs" has 7 symbols and "Cats" has 4 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 2/4, 1/4, 1/4, 4/4, 2/4, 4/4, 3/4, 4/4. How many leaves measured exactly 4/4 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 2 per symbol. The bar for "Blue" is worth 3 symbols. How many does "Blue" represent?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Reassessment. Work alone; this checks whether the repair held.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 2 per symbol, "Dogs" has 7 symbols and "Cats" has 3 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 3/4, 1/4, 2/4, 4/4, 2/4, 4/4, 2/4, 2/4. How many leaves measured exactly 2/4 inch?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 10 per symbol. The bar for "Apples" is worth 1 symbols. How many does "Apples" represent?
